initialExam.title: SSC Stenographer Grade C & D 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment for Stenographer Grade C and Grade D posts in central government. Application closed; CBE exam scheduled Jul-Aug 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th Standard pass from a recognized Board
initialExam.syllabus: General Intelligence & Reasoning (50Q), General Awareness (50Q), English Language & Comprehension (100Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Skill Test: Stenography - Grade C (100 wpm), Grade D (80 wpm).
initialExam.jobRole: Stenographer Grade C (Group B) and Grade D (Group C) in central government
initialExam.careerGrowth: Stenographer Grade D → Grade C → PA → PS → PPS through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 4 (Grade D) to Pay Level 7 (Grade C)

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension
